fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who communicate clearly, work quickly, and can remain seated for extended periods. During peak periods, dozens of people can be waiting, so you must process transactions quickly and accurately while absorbing travelers' negative emotions.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can withstand the noise of peak periods, patiently answer repeated questions, and still want to help people straighten out their journeys amid chaos, this service career offers steady rewards and a path upward.
